text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: One day, when {0} was visiting the bullettin board to accept some requests, he saw Emilia with a small girl.
text_block_list.orig_text:
依頼を受けに{0}が掲示板前へと訪れたある日。
エミリアが小さな女の子と一緒にいるのを見かけた。

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: I know I may come off as overly nosy, but I was wondering if your Mom and Dad are with you? Maybe... you got separated from them?
text_block_list.orig_text:
余計なお節介かもしれないけど、
お父さんやお母さんは一緒じゃないのかしら？
もしかして
はぐれちゃったんじゃ……

text_block_list.name: Lost Girl
text_block_list.text: *hic*... *sniff*... I don't know where... Mommy and Daddy are... BWAAAAAAHHHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ひっく……
ぐす……
わかんない……
パパも
ママも……
うわあああん！

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: Um, well, don't cry, okay? This Big Sis will help you look for them. I'm sure we'll find Mom and Dad soon...
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっと、
その、
泣かないで？
お姉ちゃんが一緒に探してあげるわ。
お父さんもお母さんも、
きっとすぐに見つかるから……

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: I wonder where on earth they got separated from each other. It doesn't seem like it's somewhere nearby, hmm...
text_block_list.orig_text:
いったい
どこではぐれちゃったのかしら。
近くにはいないみたいだし、
うーん……

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: {0}! That's what it seems like. I wanted to help her look for her parents, but she suddenly started crying... I don't even know where to start.
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}！　そうみたいなの。
一緒に探してあげたいんだけど、
泣き出しちゃって……
どこを探せばいいのかもわからないの。

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: She must be worried... Besides, if she keeps crying like this, she'll also end up exhausted. First, we have to reassure her somehow!
text_block_list.orig_text:
不安なのね……
それに、
このまま泣き続けてたら
この子もへとへとになっちゃうわ。
まずはなんとかして
安心させてあげなきゃ！

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: Why are you hiding your face all of a sudden? "It's a special move to keep kids from crying"... What is?
text_block_list.orig_text:
急に顔を隠して
どうしたの？
子供を泣き止ませるとっておき、
って
なに……？

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: Pfft, hehe... What's with you suddenly making such a strange face... hehehe!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぷっ、
ふふっ……
なに、
急にそんなへんてこな顔して……
ふふふっ！

text_block_list.name: Lost Girl
text_block_list.text: ...Ahaha, what a strange face! Aha... ahahaha♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
……あははっ、
へんなおかおー！
あはっ、
あははははっ♪

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: She has stopped crying and is laughing now.... Hehe, your special moves are truly amazing, {0}!
text_block_list.orig_text:
もう泣き止んで笑ってる……
ふふっ、
あなたのとっておきって
すごいのね！

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: What are you going to do with that coin? Grab the coin and open your hand...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
そのコインでなにかするの？
コインを握って、
手を開いて……？

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: Whoa, the coin I was supposed to be holding isn't here! Why?
text_block_list.orig_text:
わっ、
握ってたはずのコインがない！
どうして？

text_block_list.name: Lost Girl
text_block_list.text: Wow, that was amazing! How did you do that just now? Tell me, tell me!
text_block_list.orig_text:
わあ、
すごいすごーい！
いまのって
どうやったの？
教えて教えてー！

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: It's not magic, is it? Amazing! Tell me, tell me!
text_block_list.orig_text:
魔法、
でもないのよね？
すごいわ！　
教えて教えて！

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: Let's see... you were chasing butterflies when you got separated from your parents. Do you remember which way you came from?
text_block_list.orig_text:
えーと、
蝶々を追ってたら、
お母さん達とはぐれちゃったのね。
どっちから来たのか覚えてる？

text_block_list.name: Lost Girl
text_block_list.text: I don't remember...
text_block_list.orig_text: わかんない……

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: Hmm, what should I do? I don't know much about this area to begin with, I'm sure I won't find them if I just wander around aimlessly...
text_block_list.orig_text:
うーん、
どうしようかしら？
このあたりはあまり知らないから、
闇雲に歩き回っても
きっと見つからないし……

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: Huh? Where have you been, {0}? You were asking around... Wait, for this girl?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あれ、{0}、
どこかに行ってたの？
聞き込み……
って、
この子の？

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: I see. Even if she doesn't remember, the people around her might have seen where she came from.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そっか。
この子は覚えてなくても、
周りの人は
どこから来たのか見てたかもしれないものね。

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: That'd be a huge help, but are you sure I'm not bothering you {0}...? You're okay with it?
text_block_list.orig_text:
それはすごーく助かるけど、
{0}にも用事があるんじゃ……
大丈夫？

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: "Helping those in need takes priority"... Hehe, thank you!
text_block_list.orig_text:
困ってる人を助ける方が優先……
ふふっ、
ありがとう！

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: Well then, let's go look for them together! The three of us will hold hands so we don't get lost, okay?
text_block_list.orig_text:
それじゃあ、
一緒に探しに行きましょう！
迷子にならないように
三人で手を繋いで、
ね。

text_block_list.name: Street Vendor Woman
text_block_list.text: Oh, I remember that girl. She left an impression on me because I thought she was being a little reckless. I'm sure she was coming from the corner you can see on the other side over there.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ、
その子なら覚えてます。
ちょっと危なっかしいなって、
印象に残ってたので。
たしか、
向こう側に見える角から来てたはずですよ。

text_block_list.name: General Store Man
text_block_list.text: Oh, are you returning lost children to their parents again? Now that I think about it, a man and woman who looked like they were looking for a lost child passed by earlier. They were heading straight down this street, so I recommend you check over there.
text_block_list.orig_text:
おや、
また迷子の案内してるのかい？
そういえば、
さっき迷子を捜してるふうな男女が通りがかったね。
ここの通りを真っすぐ突き進んでいたから、
行ってみるといい。

text_block_list.name: The Greengrocer's wife
text_block_list.text: Ah, this child's parents called out to me a little while ago, and they said they would go looking for her in the next town soon!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ、
その子の親なら
ちょっと前に声かけてきたけど、
次は市街地の方まで捜しに行くって言ってたよ！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Then, after a bit of searching...
text_block_list.orig_text: それからしばらく捜し回った後……

text_block_list.name: Lost Girl's Mother
text_block_list.text: Ah, thank goodness... We finally found you... I'm so glad...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ、
よかった……
見つかって……
本当によかった……

text_block_list.name: Lost Girl's Father
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much for your kindness. I don't know how to thank you... What would you like? Anything I can do for you!
text_block_list.orig_text:
親切に
どうもありがとうございます。
どんなお礼をすればよいのやら……
何がよろしいですか？　
私にできる事なら何でも！

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: This girl... she looked really lonely. We just did what was natural.
text_block_list.orig_text:
この子、
すごーく寂しがってたんだもの。
私たちは
当たり前のことをしただけ。

text_block_list.name: Lost Girl
text_block_list.text: Dad, I'm hungry!
text_block_list.orig_text:
パパ、
おなかすいた！

text_block_list.name: Lost Girl's Father
text_block_list.text: Haha, so you're hungry after walking around with this mister and lady all day? Alright, then let's go eat some delicious food today.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ははっ、
お兄さんお姉さんと歩いて
お腹空いちゃったか。
よし、
今日は美味しいものを食べにいこう。

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: I'm so glad she's finally safe. Thank you for your hard work. It seems like you saved me again, {0}.
text_block_list.orig_text:
無事に済んで本当によかった。
お疲れさま。
また
助けてもらっちゃったわね。

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: Not only you helped me ask around, you also helped me find that girl's parents... Come to think of it, one man earlier remarked how you "were returning lost children to their parents again". Could it be that you're helping lost children all the time?
text_block_list.orig_text:
一緒にあの子のお母さん達を探してくれたのもそうだし、
聞き込みも……
そういえばさっき、
「また迷子の案内してる」って言われてたけど、
もしかして
普段から迷子を助けてあげてるの？

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: I knew it! You're so kind, {0}. That must be why everyone likes you so much.
text_block_list.orig_text:
やっぱり！
{0}ってすごーく優しいのね。
それでみんなにも好かれてるんだ。

text_block_list.name: Puck
text_block_list.text: Normally, if you see a lost child, you would leave them alone, or at least calm them down and wait a little, and no one would complain. Rather than being kind, isn't he a bundle of niceness?
text_block_list.orig_text:
普通、
迷子を見ても放っておくか、
お礼くらい受け取っても文句は言われないはずなのにね。
優しいっていうより、
お人よし？

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: Puck!
text_block_list.orig_text: パック！

text_block_list.name: Puck
text_block_list.text: Hey there, hey there. Thanks for looking after that lost kid and Lia both, {0}.
text_block_list.orig_text:
やあやあ。
迷子とリアの面倒を見てくれてありがとね。

text_block_list.name: Puck
text_block_list.text: You may have realized this by now, but just like the last time, Lia said, "I want to prove that I'm capable of doing things on my own." Then, while I was taking a nap, she went and put herself in trouble helping a lost child, so you really saved me.
text_block_list.orig_text:
気付いてるかもだけど、
この前と同じように
「自分一人でちゃんとしてるところを証明する」
って言い出してね。
それでお昼寝してたら
迷子を連れて困ってたもんだから助かったよ。

text_block_list.name: Puck
text_block_list.text: And here it is, his nonchalant calm attitude...! That kindness, no, that softheartedness, is such a good match for Lia's~
text_block_list.orig_text:
それでいてこの嫌味のない感じ……！
その優しさ、
いや、
お人よしは
リアといい勝負だね～

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: Geez, Puck, you jest. I'm not that softhearted or anything...
text_block_list.orig_text:
もう
パックったら。
私は別にお人よしってわけじゃ──

text_block_list.name: A Female Voice
text_block_list.text: KYAAAHHH! It's a thief!
text_block_list.orig_text:
きゃーっ！　
ひったくりよー！

text_block_list.name: Puck
text_block_list.text: He left the moment he heard the scream. What about you, Lia?
text_block_list.orig_text:
悲鳴を聞いた瞬間行っちゃった。
リアはどうする？

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: We should also go! Puck, follow me!
text_block_list.orig_text:
私たちも行きましょう！
パック、
付いてきて！

text_block_list.name: Puck
text_block_list.text: Okay, okay. ...As I already said, two peas in a pod of kindness.
text_block_list.orig_text:
はいはーい。
……やっぱり二人ともお人よしだね。

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: STOP RIGHT THERE!
text_block_list.orig_text: 待ちなさーい！

text_block_list.name: Thief
text_block_list.text: Tsk, no matter how far I run, she's right behind chasing me! Assuming that the brat I lost sight of halfway through has dropped out, all I have to do now is get rid of this silver-haired woman!
text_block_list.orig_text:
チッ、
どれだけ走っても追ってきやがる！
途中で見なくなったあのガキは脱落したとして、
あとはこの銀髪の女を撒くだけ！

text_block_list.name: Thief
text_block_list.text: I'll show you my finishing speed with a final furlong of 22 seconds!
text_block_list.orig_text:
上がり１ハロン22秒の末脚、
見せてやるぜェ！

text_block_list.name: Thief
text_block_list.text: Wha... this brat got there first!? But you're NAIVE! All I have to do is force my way through the woman behind me!
text_block_list.orig_text:
なっ……
このガキ、
先回りしてやがったな！？
だが甘かったな！　
後ろの女を強行突破すればいいだけのことよ！

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: I won't let you! Puck, please!
text_block_list.orig_text:
させない！
パック、
お願い！

text_block_list.name: Puck
text_block_list.text: Alright, leave it to me.
text_block_list.orig_text:
よーし、
任せて。

text_block_list.name: Thief
text_block_list.text: Wh-What?! An ice wall appeared in an instant?! Damn it, I can't move forward!
text_block_list.orig_text:
なっ、
氷壁が一瞬で！？
くそっ、
進めねえ！

text_block_list.name: Puck
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry. But you ended right up into a dead end.
text_block_list.orig_text:
残念でした。
ここはたった今から行き止まりだよ。

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: Now, it's time to give up! Give back what you stole!
text_block_list.orig_text:
さあ、
観念しなさい！
盗んだ物を返して！

text_block_list.name: Thief
text_block_list.text: D-Damn iiiiiiit!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ち、
畜生ぉぉぉおおお！！

text_block_list.name: Robbed Woman
text_block_list.text: Thank you for getting it back! There was a gift for my father inside. I was worried about what I would do if it had been stolen... Thank you so much! Please let me do something to show my appreciation...
text_block_list.orig_text:
取り返してくださってありがとうございます！
父への贈り物が入っていたんです。
盗られたときはどうしようかと……
本当に本当に、
ありがとうございます！　
何かお礼を……

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: No, there's no need for such grandiose thanks! More importantly, be careful not to get your stuff stolen again. We might not be nearby to help next time...
text_block_list.orig_text:
いいえ、
お礼なんて大丈夫！
それよりも、
もう盗られないように気をつけてね。
次は私たちが近くにいないかもしれないから……

text_block_list.name: Robbed Woman
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes. I'll be very careful! Once again, thank you so much.
text_block_list.orig_text:
は、
はい。
気をつけます！
本当にありがとうございました。

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: This settles the matter. {0}, who knows the city well, got ahead of us and the thief, so we didn't let him get away. The plan was a success!
text_block_list.orig_text:
これで一件落着ね。
街中に詳しい{0}が先回りしてくれたから
逃がさずに済んだわ。
作戦勝ちね！

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: ...I didn't do it because I wanted to be thanked, but when someone says "thank you" like that, it makes me feel really warm and happy.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
別にお礼を言われたくてしたことじゃないけど、
それでも
ありがとうって言われると、
すごーく温かくて、
うれしい気持ちになるわ。

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: Hehe, how strange. Whenever I'm happy, you're also happy, {0}.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふっ、
へんてこね。
私がうれしいのが、
{0}もうれしいなんて。

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: But, that makes sense. Whenever you're happy, {0}, I'm also happy!
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも、
そうかも。
{0}がうれしいと、
私もうれしいわ。

text_block_list.name: Puck
text_block_list.text: They say birds of a feather flock together～
text_block_list.orig_text: 似た者同士ってやつだね～

text_block_list.name: Restaurant Owner
text_block_list.text: HEEEYYYY, An-chan, you're right where I wanted you! Are those friends of yours? If you don't mind, could you two do some work for me?
text_block_list.orig_text:
おおーい、
あんちゃんいいところにいたな！
そっちの子はお友達かい？
よければ二人とも、
ちょっと仕事を頼まれてくれないかな。

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: Of course! Puck is taking another nap, so it would be just me.
text_block_list.orig_text:
もちろん！
パックはまたお昼寝しちゃったから、
私だけになっちゃうけど。

text_block_list.name: Restaurant Owner
text_block_list.text: Oh, it's not that big of a job. I'm running low on ingredients, so I want to go buy some. I'll be back as soon as I can, so I'll leave the shop to you to look after until then. See you!
text_block_list.orig_text:
なに、
そう大した仕事じゃないさ。
ちょっと食材のストックが少なくなってきたから
仕入れに行きたいんだ。
なるべく早く帰るから、
それまで店番を頼むよ。
それじゃ！

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: Oh, he's already gone. Still, to think he'd leave the store in your charge while he's gone, {0}... You really have a lot of people that put trust in you in this town.
text_block_list.orig_text:
わ、
もう行っちゃった。
それにしても、
お店の留守を任されるなんて、
{0}ってホントにすごーく信頼されてるのね。

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: How should I put it... It's like you're all one big family in this town. I want to have that kind of relationship with the people of Arlam Village too.
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんていうか、
街の人たちと
みんな一緒の家族みたい。
私も
アーラム村の人たちとそういう関係になりたいって、
そう思うわ。

text_block_list.name: Restaurant Owner
text_block_list.text: Wow, you guys were a lifesaver! Now I won't disappoint my customers due to lack of ingredients to cook! Because this was a sudden request, I gave you a little extra compensation. Now you can go and enjoy some delicious food!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いやー、
助かったよ二人とも！
これで
料理が出せなくてお客さんをがっかりさせることもなくなった！
急な話だったから報酬多めに入れといたよ。
これで
美味しいもの食べな！

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: Umm, but that's not necessary it's not like I...
text_block_list.orig_text:
えーと、
そんなつもりでやったわけじゃないんだけど……

text_block_list.name: Restaurant Owner
text_block_list.text: That's exactly right, this was merely a part-time job. So you have to make sure you get paid for your labor!
text_block_list.orig_text:
その通り、
これは臨時のバイトだからな。
労働の報酬は
しっかりもらっておかなきゃならん！

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: "Par-tu tai-me", I don't really get it, but... In that case, I'll take it. Thank you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
『ばいと』はよくわからないけど……
それなら、
ちゃんと受け取らせてもらいます。
ありがとう。

text_block_list.name: Restaurant Owner
text_block_list.text: I'll ask you again next time! Oh, and... please bring back home some of our specialty skewers too! They're delicious!
text_block_list.orig_text:
次もまた頼むよ！
あ、
それから……
うちの店自慢の
串焼きも持っていってくれ！

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: But... you already gave us the "Par-tu tai-me" reward...
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも、
もう
『ばいと』の報酬は……

text_block_list.name: Restaurant Owner
text_block_list.text: Please just take 'em. I want you two to have a taste, so just look at this as a freebie. If it makes your dinner a little more luxurious tonight, I'll be happy too.
text_block_list.orig_text:
受け取っといてくれよ。
これは俺が
二人に受け取ってほしくて渡すのさ。
あんたたちの今日の夕飯が
少し豪華になれば、
俺もうれしいからな。

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: Ah, he's already gone.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ、
行っちゃった。

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: I'm glad to see you're happy with them. I'm even more happy whenever I see you satisfied like this... But maybe this is exactly just like Puck said.
text_block_list.orig_text:
喜んでもらえてよかった。
{0}も、
同じ気持ちみたいでなおさらね。
でも、
これだとやっぱり
パックの言ってた通りなのかも。

text_block_list.name: Butcher's Shop Owner
text_block_list.text: Hey, Nii-chan! Perfect timing to be here! There's something I need your help with!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おーい、
兄ちゃん！　
ちょうどいいところにいた！
ちょっと手伝ってほしいことがあるんだ！

text_block_list.name: Bakery lady
text_block_list.text: Can you come to my house after you finish working at the butcher's?! We don't have enough delivery staff!
text_block_list.orig_text:
肉屋さんが終わったら
うちにもきてくれない！？
配達の手が足りないの！

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: Wow, you've been called for again, {0}. You're so popular...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
わっ、
また呼ばれちゃった。
すごーく人気者なのね……！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: And so, by the time evening came around, the two had received an armful of gifts and returned to the Salendia Orphanage.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうして、夕方になる頃には、一抱えほどもお礼の品を受け取って
二人はサレンディア救護院に戻ってきた。

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text: The specialty skewers from the shop on the main street, the best bacon from the butcher, freshly baked baguettes from the bakery, potatoes and tomatoes from the greengrocer... That's a surprisingly huge amount of food, I'm surprised the two of you managed to get it all back home like this.
text_block_list.orig_text:
大通りのお店の名物串焼きに、
お肉屋さんのとびきりベーコン、
パン屋さんの焼きたてバゲット、
八百屋さんのジャガイモに
トマトに……
すごい量だけど、
よく二人で持って帰ってこられたわね。

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: "Par-tu tai-me" rewards {0} said, but then they ended up giving us all sorts of freebies... He also said that we should let the kids here at the orphanage have a taste of all of this.
text_block_list.orig_text:
『ばいと』と、
後は
個人的なお礼にって
たくさんもらっちゃって……
救護院の子どもたちにも
食べさせてくれって言ってたわ。

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text: Heehee, I imagined. I heard you two were working around all day helping all sorts of people. Seems like you had quite the fulfilling day.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふっ、
そうみたいね。
二人が頑張って人助けしてたって、
あたしまで評判が届いてたわ。
充実した一日を過ごせていたみたいじゃない。

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: Yes! It was a really fulfilling day! But it left me exhausted...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ええ！　
すごーく充実した一日だったわ！
そのぶん、
へとへとになっちゃったけど……

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text: I'm sure you are. Well then, shall we have dinner today using the gifts you brought back with you? Please tell me all about what you two did today.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうでしょうね。
それじゃあ、
今日は二人のお土産を使ったお夕飯にしましょうか。
二人の今日の活躍も、
たくさん聞かせてね。

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: Thank you for today, {0}. It was great to see so many happy faces.
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}、今日はありがとう。
たくさん喜ぶ顔が見れて
うれしかったわ。

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: Let's do some "Par-tu tai-me" work together again next time. ...This is our second promise!
text_block_list.orig_text:
また今度、
一緒に
『ばいと』しましょうね。
二つ目の、
約束。

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Thus, feeling fulfilled and comfortably tired, Emilia and {0} ended their day at the Salendia Orphanage surrounded by smiles they took part in.
text_block_list.orig_text:
こうして、充足感と心地よい疲労を感じながら、
エミリアたちはサレンディア救護院で一日を終えるのだった。
